title: Shorter paths to text generation
summary:
Text generation got a simpler URL, publishable keys became easier to use, and Seedream 4.0 joined the image lineup.

A new GET text endpoint accepts a prompt in the URL and an optional model parameter, defaulting to openai. Enter also added copyable publishable API keys and support for using them in GET text and image URLs; secret keys remain masked and use the Authorization header.

ByteDance ARK Seedream 4.0 was added for Nectar-tier image generation, with a configured maximum side length of 2048 pixels. The same change fixed authentication for publishable keys; a smaller update corrected provider labels for kontext and turbo.

The tier panel now displays updated daily Pollen amounts and explains refill timing and non-carryover. It also adds guidance for people whose tier differs between the older auth site and Enter. The Pollen FAQ now links to a vote on payment methods. The tier change updated displayed amounts, not the code that grants Pollen.

highlights.title: Text from a GET request
highlights.text: Generate text by putting a prompt in a GET URL. An optional model parameter defaults to openai. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Copyable publishable API keys
highlights.text: Create a publishable key in Enter, copy it later, and use it in the `key` parameter of GET text and image requests. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Seedream 4.0 image generation
highlights.text: Generate images with ByteDance ARK Seedream 4.0 on the Nectar tier, with a configured maximum side length of 2048 pixels. [Find Seedream on Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream).
